NineSwordTechniques:TheCanonOfSwordObser.NAME: The Canon of Sword Observation
NineSwordTechniques:TheCanonOfSwordObser.FLAVOR: Crafted by Bazun'an, the Eighth Sword Immortal, who mastered every art created by the Sword Ancestor.
DESCRIPTIONS: On pickup, Enlighten #b1 time. NL Enlighten: Choose an unevolved base Sword Technique card and replace it with its evolved form. If none can evolve, upgrade a random card and gain #b5 Max HP.

NineSwordTechniques:TheYousiSword.NAME: Fierce Sword: Yousi
NineSwordTechniques:TheYousiSword.FLAVOR: The most fearsome sword under heaven.
DESCRIPTIONS: Attack cards deal #b50% more damage. Whenever you play an Attack, lose #b1 HP.

NineSwordTechniques:FlameSwordYanmang.NAME: Flame Sword: Yanmang
NineSwordTechniques:FlameSwordYanmang.FLAVOR: The blade strikes like a serpent, leaving wildfire in its wake.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you play an Attack each turn, deal #b4 damage to ALL enemies.

NineSwordTechniques:EmberSeed.NAME: Emberlight Seed
NineSwordTechniques:EmberSeed.FLAVOR: Before the flame awakens, it scorches its bearer.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you win a combat, lose #b6 Max HP. After #b4 victories, evolve into Emberlight White Flame.

NineSwordTechniques:EmberWhiteFlame.NAME: Emberlight White Flame
NineSwordTechniques:EmberWhiteFlame.FLAVOR: At the end of the ashes, a white flame is born.
DESCRIPTIONS: On pickup, gain #b30 Max HP. At the start of each turn, non-Boss enemies lose #b10% of their Max HP; Boss enemies lose #b5% instead.
